sentences.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission’s Operation Godrevy investigated allegations of preferential travel-pass treatment and misuse of electorate staff for party campaigning.
sentences.support:
The scope of the Commission's investigation was to form opinions as to 
whether any public officer engaged in serious misconduct

sentences.text: The Commission formed no opinion that serious misconduct had occurred in either allegation.
sentences.support:
The Commission has formed no opinion of serious misconduct with respect 
to this allegation.

sentences.text: The Commission concluded that missing time records prevented verification of claims that campaigning during office hours was offset by public duties performed later.
sentences.support:
The absence of accurate documentation of hours worked made it 
impossible for the Commission to verify claims

sentences.text: The Commission considered the absence of electorate office time recording a serious misconduct risk.
sentences.support:
In the Commission's opinion, if an MP does not utilise a time recording 
system in their electorate office

sentences.text: The Commission made three recommendations to introduce time recording, clarify restrictions on party work and provide a constituent management system.
sentences.support:
DPC 
implement a time recording procedure for MPs to use in each electorate 
office.

findings.quote:
The absence of accurate documentation of hours worked made it 
impossible for the Commission to verify claims that campaigning work 
during office hours was made up for by public duties performed outside 
those hours.

In the Commission's opinion, if an MP does not utilise a time recording 
system in their electorate office, their failure to do so is a serious 
misconduct risk.

notes: The Introduction contains the overall findings and recommendations. Three distinct recommendations are stated in paragraphs 34–35 and repeated in the Conclusion. The Commission’s suspicions about campaigning are not presented as proven misconduct; witnesses are unnamed in the summary.
